span.p:
File 1.1: verify_dataset.py
Pre-Flight Integrity Check
Checks 8,732 UrbanSound8K slices & class distribution

div.style: color: rgb(13, 71, 161) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
File 1.2: extract_features.py
Runs 1st (Core Preprocessing)
• Slices custom audio to 4.0s (stride 2.0s)
• Within-fold 1:1 balanced sampling
• STFT + 128 Mel bands + Log dB compression

div.style: color: rgb(38, 50, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

Dtype: float32 (133.2 MB)

span.p:
y_labels.npy
Shape: (2066,)
Binary: 1=Gunshot, 0=Noise

div.style: color: rgb(38, 50, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
fold_assignments.npy
Shape: (2066,)
10-Fold CV IDs [1..10]

div.style: color: rgb(49, 27, 146) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
File 2.1: train_model.py
Runs 2nd (Deep Learning Engine)
• SpecAugment: Time/Freq masking + Gaussian noise
• Z-Score Feature Standardization across 16,128 features
• Conv2D + Dual 1D Temporal Pooling Architecture
• 10-Fold Cross-Validation evaluation
• Full-Integer INT8 Post-Training Quantization (PTQ)

span.p:
File 3.1: app/gunshot_listener.py
Runs 3rd (Real-Time Edge Daemon)
• Continuous 16 kHz sampling via sounddevice
• Volatile 4.0s circular RAM ring buffer (deque)

div.style: color: rgb(245, 127, 23) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
RMS Wake-Up Gate
RMS Energy > 0.015?
(Evaluated every 10ms)

div.style: color: rgb(27, 94, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Sleep 10ms & Overwrite Buffer
(Citizen Privacy Preserved)

div.style: color: rgb(27, 94, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Freeze 4.0s Buffer Snapshot
Capture arrival timestamp (t_arrival)

div.style: color: rgb(27, 94, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
On-Device INT8 Inference
• Compute Log-Mel Spectrogram (128x126)
• Normalize: (features - mean) / std
• Quantize: round(features / scale) + zero_point
• Invoke TFLite Interpreter (~35-45ms)

div.style: color: rgb(245, 127, 23) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Confidence Gate
Prediction >= 0.75?

span.p:

File 4.1: zomes/integrity/lib.rs
Deterministic Rust WASM Physical Rules
• len(observations) >= 3
• Coordinate sanity: is_finite() (!NaN/!Inf)
• Physical Causality: |t_i - t_j| <= (d_ij / 343) + 50ms
